@extended_eta_identity : ∀ {nPublic nPadding : ℕ} (eta : Ext6Q) (trace : ℕ → Ext6Q) (traceLength : ℕ)
  (terminalValues : Fin 7 → Ext6Q) (terminal : Fin 7 → TraceAffineFunctional) (publicValues : Fin nPublic → Ext6Q),
  (∀ (j : Fin 7), terminalValues j = (terminal j).eval trace) →
    (∀ (j : Fin nPublic), trace ↑j = publicValues j) →
      (∀ (j : Fin nPadding), trace (traceLength + ↑j) = 0) →
        ∑ j, eta ^ ↑j * (extendedValues terminalValues publicValues j - extendedConstants terminal j) =
          (Finsupp.linearCombination Ext6Q trace) (etaBatchedWeights eta (extendedWeights terminal traceLength))
@card_bad_extended_eta_le : ∀ {nPublic nPadding : ℕ} (challenges : Finset Ext6Q) (trace : ℕ → Ext6Q) (traceLength : ℕ)
  (terminalValues : Fin 7 → Ext6Q) (terminal : Fin 7 → TraceAffineFunctional) (publicValues : Fin nPublic → Ext6Q),
  (∃ j,
      extendedValues terminalValues publicValues j ≠
        extendedConstants terminal j +
          (Finsupp.linearCombination Ext6Q trace) (extendedWeights terminal traceLength j)) →
    {eta ∈ challenges |
          ∑ j,
              eta ^ ↑j *
                openingDefect trace (extendedValues terminalValues publicValues) (extendedConstants terminal)
                  (extendedWeights terminal traceLength) j =
            0}.card ≤
      6 + nPublic + nPadding
coordinatePolynomial_eval : ∀ (project : Ext6Q →ₗ[BabyBear] BabyBear) (p : Ext6Q[X]) (x : BabyBear),
  Polynomial.eval x (coordinatePolynomial project p) = project (Polynomial.eval ((algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) x) p)
card_eval_in_baseImage_le : ∀ (domain : Finset BabyBear) (d : ℕ) (project : Ext6Q →ₗ[BabyBear] BabyBear) (p : Ext6Q[X]),
  (∀ (a : BabyBear), project ((algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) a) = 0) →
    coordinatePolynomial project p ≠ 0 →
      p.degree < ↑d →
        {x ∈ domain | ∃ a, Polynomial.eval ((algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) x) p = (algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) a}.card ≤
          d - 1
card_sampledOracle_in_baseImage_le : ∀ (samples : Finset BabyBear) (d : ℕ) (oracle : BabyBear → Ext6Q) (p : Ext6Q[X])
  (project : Ext6Q →ₗ[BabyBear] BabyBear),
  SamplesRepresentPolynomial oracle p samples →
    (∀ (a : BabyBear), project ((algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) a) = 0) →
      coordinatePolynomial project p ≠ 0 →
        p.degree < ↑d → {x ∈ samples | ∃ a, oracle x = (algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) a}.card ≤ d - 1
